intent: A slim announcement strip above a site header: rotating messages roll vertically, a badge shimmers once, and dismissing collapses the height so the page glides up.

layout.strip: section, overflow hidden, bg #0b0b0c, border-b white/8%; inner max-w 1280px is the @container
layout.desktop: grid 96px | 1fr | 96px, px 24px: pager | centred message | dismiss
layout.mobile: grid 1fr | auto, left-aligned message, pager hidden, whole row is the link
layout.message: badge, one-line text with ellipsis, link + arrow; `short` text under 896px

color.pager: 16×3px segments, track white/16%, fill white/90 (white/55 paused)

motion.roll: keyed AnimatePresence; enter y ±100% + blur 4px → 0, exit the other way; 500ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); direction-aware when jumping back
motion.shimmer: single sweep x -110% → 110%, 900ms ease-in-out, 350ms delay; never loops
motion.timer: rAF accumulates elapsed (5200ms default) into a motion value driving the active segment scaleX; pauses on hover, focus, offscreen, hidden tab
motion.dismiss: content fades 140ms, then height → 0 over 320ms cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)
motion.reducedMotion: no autoplay, opacity-only swaps, no shimmer, instant collapse

responsive.1440: pager left, centred long message, link label
responsive.390: badge + short text + arrow, 44px dismiss, whole row tappable

accessibility: aria-live off while rotating, polite when paused
pager buttons labelled 'Announcement n of N' with aria-current
rotation pauses whenever focus is inside the strip

messages: New — Outpost 3.0 is here: incidents now draft their own postmortems. Read the release
Event — Incident Week, 14–16 November: four talks, zero slide decks. Save a seat
Beta — The Terraform provider now manages on-call rotas as code. View the docs
content.demo: strip over a minimal header silhouette on black, with a 'Bring the strip back' stage button after dismissal

avoid: brand gradient bars or marquee scrolling
removing the strip without animating its height
